S1.note: URL becomes ?sources=user_upload. Because sources filter is non-empty, hasAnyUserFilter=true so narrowReason resolves to 'filter' (body_filter copy + Clear filters button) even though this was a tab click, not the Filters popover. Matches source logic exactly — not a bug, just naming overlap between 'tab' and 'filter' concepts.

S2.name: Grid view toggled — POTENTIAL BUG: main content scroll container gains persistent horizontal overflow/scroll offset
S2.note: See keyFindings — confirmed via evaluate_script: the main scroll container (div.flex.min-h-0.flex-1.flex-col.gap-6.overflow-y-auto.px-4.py-6.sm:px-8) reported scrollWidth=1085 vs clientWidth=965 (120px horizontal overflow) at 1280px viewport, and scrollLeft was auto-set to 120 after clicking the Grid view radio (rightmost element in the toolbar row). Toggling back to List view did NOT reset scrollLeft — the shift persisted, clipping the search box/title/left column out of the viewport until manually scrolled back. Root cause candidate: Tailwind 'overflow-y-auto' implicitly makes overflow-x 'auto' too (CSS overflow shorthand quirk), and some row/header content (likely the grouped-section header with right-aligned date, e.g. '(8 files) ... 6/15') is ~120px wider than the container at this viewport width, which is not supposed to require horizontal scrolling for a file browser toolbar.

keyFindings: No login wall encountered; session from prior authenticated tab carried over correctly.

Page has NO upload entry point / button on /files itself. 'My Uploads' is a source-filter TAB (sources=user_upload), not an upload action — confirmed via source grep (no upload button/dropzone in features/files/*). Page-specific note asking to explore 'upload entry point' does not apply to this route; uploading likely happens elsewhere (e.g. task/chat attach flow).

No folder/breadcrumb navigation exists on this page — files are grouped by task/channel (collapsible sections) or by type via the GroupBy popover, not a folder hierarchy. This is by design per source (FilesGroupBy = 'none'|'task'|'type').

POTENTIAL BUG: switching to Grid view (radio 'Grid view') causes the main content scroll container to overflow horizontally by ~120px at a standard 1280px desktop viewport and auto-scrolls right, clipping the page title/search box out of view. Switching back to List view does not restore scrollLeft to 0, leaving the misalignment persistent until the user manually scrolls left. Reproduced twice via evaluate_script measurement (scrollWidth 1085 vs clientWidth 965, scrollLeft stuck at 120). Recommend filing as a UI/layout bug against Files Grid view — verify with a real Playwright test asserting `mainScrollContainer.scrollWidth === mainScrollContainer.clientWidth` after toggling view modes.

Minor cosmetic observation (not filed as bug): the 'Mira Generated' source tab renders as 'Mira11111 Generated' on this test account — twinName interpolation is working as coded, but the literal value 'Mira11111' looks like test/seed data rather than a real twin name; flagging in case it surfaces in a shared/demo environment.
